blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Another wave of power interruptions is expected to hit consumers in the Visayas on Thursday as the region continues to suffer from a thin electricity supply. The Visayas would be under a red alert for five hours, from 4 p.m. to 9 p.m., said the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines.
